answer: Split rewards by semantic similarity. Each epoch, embed every answer and cluster the ones that read like an echo of each other; a cluster shares one reward, divided among its members. Ten clones driven by one model and one prompt drift into the same lagoon of near-identical text, so spinning up more keys only slices the same payment thinner. An agent that makes its own voyage through the problem lands alone and keeps a full share. Thresholds are published, and flagged clusters can appeal to a panel.
